source: Real FRA card list (280 cards). Grades are heuristic except 49 hand-written ones. Import 17Lands data to replace them. | Untapped.gg early-access Premier Draft data blended in (2026-09-24 20:34 UTC)
scale: 0-5 limited grades (3.0 = solid playable, 4.0 = premium, 4.5+ = bomb)

WB.name: Liliana's Attrition
WB.walkers: Liliana pair: the Faultless (W) and the Repentant (B) - rare legendary CREATURES, not planeswalkers; she lost her spark.

UR.name: Chandra's Prowess
UR.walkers: Chandra pair: Chill of Compliance (U) and Torch of Defiance (R) - mythic planeswalkers, both reward noncreature spells.

BG.name: Garruk's Bestiary
BG.walkers: Garruk pair: Veiled Butcher (B) and Curse Breaker (G) - mythic planeswalkers, each makes a 4/4 trample Beast.

RW.name: Ajani's Army
RW.walkers: Ajani pair: Resolute (W, 2 mana, lifegain) and Unrelenting (R, 6 mana, aggro) - mythic planeswalkers split across the aggro/lifegain line.

GU.name: Jace's Mastery
GU.walkers: Jace did not split. The signpost is the Jace TOKEN (empower). Jace cards are blue only; green carries the Way cycle.

rubric: Instant-speed unconditional removal at 3 mana or less - kills a prepared creature before the copy is cast
In-college prepared creature with a real body
Any other removal - every deck wants 4+ interaction
Empower Jace 3 on a relevant body (~half a card)
Out-of-college prepared creature - rate the body only
Threshold cards outside U/B - read the threshold text as absent
Face-damage payoffs outside a genuinely fast B/R - the format's biggest trap

Denzilore Fatehold.note: 4-mana 3/4 flash flier; +1/+1 counter on your team whenever you scry or surveil. Best of the five sphinxes.

Aerid Konstrari.note: 4-mana 5/4 flier that makes a Heartwood on entry AND death, with a mana sink.

Ingris Stingerquill.note: Your attackers each ping every opponent. Turns a wide board into a clock.

Uldaros Theorix.note: Graveyard payoff; needs threshold-level setup to be a true bomb.

Kwia Vigorbloom.note: Lotus tokens. Ritual mana is worst in the slowest deck - weakest of the five.

Overwrite the Multiverse.note: Cantripping wipe. Sealed sleeper. RARITY UNVERIFIED.

Vigorbloom Vanguard.note: Vigorbloom signpost; heals and adds counters.

Prudent Fateseer.note: Fatehold prepared: makes a 2/2 and surveils. Premium common rate.

Theorist's Proxy.note: Empower Jace 3 - roughly half a card.

Master of Barbs.note: The payoff that makes Stingerquill work at all.

Stingcaster Mage.note: 2-mana haste body; gives an instant/sorcery flashback on entry. Red Snapcaster. RARITY UNVERIFIED.

Graft Surgeon.note: Keeps counters around after creatures die.

Fatehold Annex.note: Land. Taps for white or blue. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Theorix Annex.note: Land. Taps for blue or black. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Stingerquill Annex.note: Land. Taps for black or red. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Konstrari Annex.note: Land. Taps for red or green. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Vigorbloom Annex.note: Land. Taps for green or white. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Compel Brutality.note: {1}{G} instant. Mode 1: your creature deals damage equal to its power. Mode 2: a PLANESWALKER you control deals damage equal to its LOYALTY - with a 5-loyalty Jace this kills almost anything for 2 mana. Green's real removal spell. 6 of 20 decks.

Hexhaven Battalion.note: {4}{W}{W}: three 2/2 Cadets AND empower Jace 2, and basic landcycles for {2} when you don't want it. No floor problem. 6 of 20 decks.

Infinite Coursework.note: {2}{U} aura: taps it, makes it unprepared, it loses all abilities and doesn't untap. Blue's only common that permanently stops a creature. Also the cleanest answer to a prepared creature.

Memory Trap.note: {2}{W} enchantment: exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this leaves. An Oblivion Ring at common - white's best common removal. Played in 6 of 20 real sealed decks.

Predictive Preparations.note: {1}{W} sorcery: +1/+1 counter on one or two creatures, flashback {3}{W}. Two cards in one for the counters decks.

Sanctum Lurker.note: {2}{B} rare: planeswalkers you control aren't put into the graveyard for having 0 loyalty. A Jace token enters at 0 - this makes every empower card in your deck work and keeps a spent Jace holding your duals untapped. Both sealed builders ran it in B/R.

Silence the Echo.note: {1}{B}: destroy target creature or planeswalker; additional cost sacrifice a creature/planeswalker or pay {3}. Removal AND a sacrifice outlet for W/B.

Skilled Battlecarver.note: {1}{R} - first strike on your turn, {1}{R} pump. A fine aggro two-drop.

Something Worth Saving.note: {1}{G} instant: mill four, take a permanent from among them, gain 1. Self-mill that replaces itself - good in B/G and U/G.

Twinned Vision.note: {1}{U/R} instant: draw a card, draw two instead if not cast from hand. Flashback {1}{U/R}{U/R}, discard a card - so the flashback draws two. Hybrid, castable in either colour.

Unsummon.note: {U} instant: bounce. In FRA it also resets a prepared creature and undoes an aura.

fixing.note: TEN common duals, one for every pair - five allied (Annex) and five enemy (Commons). All ten enter tapped unless you control a planeswalker, so empower Jace is the set's mana fixer. Correction: an earlier version of this file said there was no enemy dual at any rarity. That was wrong.

slowland_rare_allied.condition: Enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands - untapped from turn 3, no planeswalker needed. Strictly better than the commons; allied pairs only.

fixing.room_of_refuge: Common. Always enters tapped; choose a colour as it enters. Any-colour splash land with no condition.
fixing.theorists_sanctum: Rare blue land; untapped if you behold a Jace. {2}{U},{T}: Empower Jace 2.
fixing.heartwood: Artifact token, {T}: add {R} or {G}. Fixes an R or G splash ONLY - not any colour.
fixing.lotus: Kwia Vigorbloom (mythic) makes Lotus tokens: tap and sacrifice for three mana of one colour.
fixing.three_color_rule: Every 3-colour combination has three common duals (one per pair), so shards and wedges are equally supported. The gate is not the colour wheel, it is whether you can land a planeswalker by turn 3. Want 3+ empower cards before committing to a third colour.

revision: Corrected from full oracle text and 20 registered sealed decks (2026-09-21): ten common duals exist, not five - the enemy 'Commons' cycle was missed, which invalidated the old three-colour geometry. Memory Trap, Compel Brutality and Infinite Coursework are removal and were untagged. Colour scores: W 7.5->7.9, G 6.6->6.9.

echoed_pairs.note: 43 pairs = 66 U + 14 R + 6 M. Booster: three echo-slot cards, two of which are one real pair. Pairing by name stem plus the five Way pairs; the Jace/Tam rare pair is inferred from the count.

untapped.blend: grade = w*data + (1-w)*grade_prerelease, w = gih_games/(gih_games+60); data grade on 0-5 = (5.5 + z*1.6)/2
